tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bum thang lha'i sbas yul gyi bkod pa me tog

skyed tshal zhes bya ba bzhugs/ oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ bum thang lha'i sbas yul gyi bkod pa gsal bar byed pa me tog gi skyed mos tshal zhes bya ba/ ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha yi mchog dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang*/ /drang srong grub pa rig sngags 'chang rnams kyi/ /thor tshugs g.yo bas gang gi zhabs btud pa/ /rang byung pad+ma dad brgya'i gtsug gis mchod/ /sngon gyi rgyal blon mchog rnams byon pa'i yul/ /ngo mtshar gtsug lag khang rnams bzhugs pa'i yul/ /mkhas grub du ma brgyud par byon pa'i yul/ /bum thang lha yi sbas yul bkod pa gson/ /dbus dang phyogs bzhi yangs pa'i rang bzhin yul/ /kun nas zlum pa bum pa'i 'khor lo dang*/ /pad+ma kha bye lta bur mdzes pa la/ /mi yul mi 'dra lha yul 'phos pa bzhin/ /ri rnams nyams dga' sngo zhing snum pa la/ /rtse mo dkar gsal gangs ri'i phreng tshogs can/ /mtho khyad mnyam zhing phyogs rnams 'khor ba ni/ /rin chen ra bas kun nas bskor ba bzhin/ /lung rnams thang yangs me tog 'bras mang la/ /grong rnams yid 'ong pad+ma mang pos gang*/ /phyogs rnams mdangs gsal dpal gyis mdzes pa ni/ /lha rnams yul la 'gran pa lags sam snyam/ /yul 'di bum pa'i thang zhes grags pa yang*/ /rab sna'i dbus ri bum pa lta bu'i 'dabs/ /byang ngos thang la thog mar yul btab pas/ /nye ba'i sgra yis de skad btags so kye/ /'di yi rang bzhin kun nas mdzes pa la/ /phyogs kyi yul phran mang pos bskor ba ni/ /lhun po gser ri mang pos brgyan pa la/ /gling bzhi gling phran mang pos bskor ba bzhin/ /de lta'i yul dbus yangs pa'i lte ba la/ /rab sna'i lung pa kun nas mdzes pa ni/ /pad sdong rtse na byams pa bzhugs pa 'dra/ /dwangs pa'i chu klung dag kyang shar du 'bab/ /lung bzang srol ni pad+ma'i rtsa ba la/ /rtse mo bang rim 'dab stong rgyas 'dra'i steng*/ /byang ri byams pa rgyal po gdan bzhugs la/

/thar pa'i gling gis nye bar mdzes pa lags/ /sa rnams 'dab brgyad pad+ma lta bu la/ /gnam yang 'khor lo rtsibs stong bkod pa bzhin/ /mdangs bkra nyi zla'i 'od kyang rgyang ring la/ /phyogs kyi ri dang yul rnams 'dud pa bzhin/ /sa mkhan rin chen dam pas bsngags pa'i gzhi/ /rgyal ba'i sa ste bkra shis phun sum tshogs/ /grub ri rin chen 'byung ba'i bsti gnas te/ /rang byung pad+ma rgyal po'i mgon dang bcas/ /'di yi phyogs bzhi pad+ma 'dab ma la/ /yul khams bzhi dang gzhung chu 'bab pa'i tshul/ /so so'i ya mtshan du mas brgyan pa ni/ /sngon med sgyu ma'i rtsed mtsho bkod pa bzhin/ /rang bzhin bum thang sde bzhir grags pa ni/ /rab sna mo re steng chu mang sde'i yul/ /bzhi po sngon nas yod phyir sde bzhi la/ /u ra phyi nas bod kyis btags par 'dod/ /de nas shar phyogs rta chu'i lung pa ni/ /rin chen shing rta'i dbyibs ltar mdzes pa la/ /yul rnams dar zhing mi rnams bde skyid 'phel/ /rin chen chu bo shar nas nub tu 'bab/ /yul 'di'i phu na sbas yul sgo yod la/ /bar na dpal phug brag la zhabs rjes dang*/ /mda' na chos kyi gter mtshan du ma yod/ /ding sang ri mo can zhes grags pa yin/ /sman shing me tog 'bras bu'i tshogs mang la/ /yul khams yangs shing lo thog sna dgu 'khrungs/ /phyogs kyi tshong zong dag kyang grangs mang la/ /yul lha'i mchog kyang gzhan las 'phags pa lags/ /shar lho rin chen u ra'i lung pa ni/ /'khor lo'i dbyibs ltar zlum zhing mdzes pa la/ /grong rnams dar zhing yul 'khor shin tu mang*/ /rin chen chu bo lho nub dal gyis 'bab/ /'di yi phu la dngos grub gnas yod la/ /bar gyi phyogs mtshams dgon pa'i gnas kyis bskor/ /mda' na rab 'jigs bdud mtsho mer ba las/ /drag po'i sgra skad sna tshogs 'byung ba yod/ /rtswa rnams bcud che rkang 'gros gzhan las 'phel/ /shing rnams 'bras bzang nags tshal phun sum tshogs/

/sman rnams mthu che nad kyi rigs nyung la/ /yul rnams nyams dga' yon tan dpag tu med/ /yul 'di bod yul dbus dang 'dra ba ste/ /bsil drod mnyam la ston dus lan gcig 'byung/ /chos rgyal rje yi gdung rabs bzhugs pa dang*/ /gtsang ma'i bod rnams gnas pas khyad par 'phags/ /lho phyogs lung srol rab tu bzang po la/ /bum thang yul gyi gzhung chu 'bab pa ni/ /thog mar lhor 'bab de nas lho nub tu/ /gaṅgā'i chu dang 'dres te song ba la/ /ba tshwa can gyi rgya mtsho chen por 'bab/ /yang yang gangs ṛ'i mgul nas 'ongs pa'i chu/ /chil chil rlabs kyis gnyer ba'i rgyun babs pa/ /lhung lhung chab sgra snyan pa'i glu len cing*/ /'deng 'deng zhes sgrogs lho phyogs snyegs la gzigs/ /brgyad ldan chu 'bab rin chen chu bo yang*/ /dad brgya'i rba rlabs g.yo bas rab bskyod de/ /rdo rje gdan sogs 'phags pa'i yul rnams su/ /yon chab 'bul phyir chas pa yin nam snyam/ /dwangs pa'i chu gtsang lbu 'phreng 'dzin pa ni/ /rin chen baiḍūr bzhu ba'i khu ba'am/ /an+da rnyil dang ston ka'i nam mkha' bzhin/ /yang na g.yu thag legs par brkyangs pa 'dra/ /'di ni gangs dang sman dri'i sding rnams dang*/ /sman shing me tog can nas legs 'bab pa'i/ /'thung dang khrus byas yon tan dpag tu med/ /chu ngogs gzhan las mchog tu 'phags pa lags/ /nub phyogs mang sde'i yul khams bzang po ni/ /yid 'ong gzhu yi dbyibs ltar mdzes pa la/ /grong rnams myur zhing phyogs kyi skye bo 'du/ /chu bo'i rgyun yang nub nas shar lhor 'bab/ /'di yi phu na nags ri'i tshogs mang zhing*/ /bar du 'bru mang sman shing lo 'bras 'phel/ /mda' na 'bras dang khre dang yon la sogs/ /'bru sna mang la ja shing bzang po skye/ /sbrang dang btsod dang ya mtshar la sogs pa/ /tshong zong grangs mang dar dang ras bal sogs/ /shing dang sa las 'khrungs pa'i bza' ba yang*/ /ro mchog brgyad ldan du mar ldan pa dang*/

/bu ram shing dang kha zas rnam pa mang*/ /mang sde'i yul zhes ming don mthun par grags/ /byang phyogs me ri'i lung pa bzang po ni/ /dpag bsam ljon shing rgyas pa lta bu la/ /yul khams dar zhing sa phyogs gzi brjid che/ /dwangs pa'i chu bo byang nas lho phyogs 'bab/ /'di yi phu na bod kyi sgo yod la/ /gangs ri'i phreng ba dar dkar yol ba bzhin/ /sngon tshe pad+mas dkyil 'khor bzhengs pa'i thang*/ /srin po btul pa'i rdo dang bcas pa yod/ /bar na thang yangs chu bo'i shar phyogs la/ /bsam yas me btsa' chos 'khoralha khang dang*/ /nub na byams pa sgrol ma'i lha khang gnyis/ /lha sa 'u shang rdo yi lha khang bzhengs/ /de dang nye ba'i byang ri'i brag logs la/ /rang byung pad+ma rgyal po'i sku rjes yod/ /de ni lan gcig mthong ba tsam gyis kyang*/ /ngan song sgo bcad mtho ris thar lam bgrod/ /mda' na sngon gyi rgyal po'i yul mkhar dang*/ /blon po'i grong yod rgyal blon sa zhes grags/ /'di yi mi rnams mchog tu rigs bzang la/ /gzugs kyang gzhan las mchog tu 'phags pa lags/ /bum thang rin chen lha yi sbas yul gyi/ /ri rnams lhun stug sa ral grog po med/ /yul rnams nyams dga' ston dus 'khor mar 'byung*/ /mi rnams bcos bzang sngon gyi khrims la gnas/ /yid 'ong grong rnams 'phyong kha phyed phibs can/ /snyug ma'i sbag khang dag kyang grangs mang la/ /mkhar dang khang bzang shing gi rgya phibs can/ /rgyang nas lha yi khang bzang mthong ba 'dra/ /'di na mi rnams rang bzhin dge ba ste/ /ri dwags mi rngon lam srong chom po med/ /rkun po nyung zhing gzhan gnod 'tshe ba chung*/ /ngang gis rgyud 'jam 'grogs na bde ba lags/ /yul 'di'i mi rnams brnyas su mi rung ste/ /kha cig dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i rigs yin la/ /la la phrin las gnyan sa gnon la mkhas/ /phal rnams mchog tu ngo tsha che ba lags/ /'di na lugs bzang glo bur lhags la byams/ /gang du 'gro yang lam rgyags mi dgos la/

/nye du'i khyim las lhag pa'i sna len dang*/ /bya dga' che bas bskal pa bzang po bzhin/ /yul 'di'i rang bzhin zhib mor bsam pa na/ /dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing las lhag pa bzhin/ /'tshe ba med pas dam chos sgrub pa'i gnas/ /yul khams gzhan las khyad par 'phags so kye/ /de 'dra'i yul dbus pad+ma'i lte ba la/ /rab sna'i ri rgyal kun nas mdzes pa ni/ /'khor los sgyur rgyal kun nas bskor ba bzhin//phyogs kyi ri rnams 'di la 'khor bar 'dud/ /rin chen 'dzin ma'i lhun po chen po yang*/ /sna tshogs bkod pa'i 'od zer stong 'phro zhing*/ /grub pa'i bsti gnas bzang pos brgyan pa ni/ /shar ri lag na pad+mo'i bzhugs gnas bzhin/ /dbyar dus an+da rnyil gyi sa 'dzin la/ /nor bu nyi zla'i 'od kyi mdangs 'tsher ba/ /sngon med lha yi rin chen lhun po yang*/ /phyogs 'dir 'phos na de dang mtshungs pa snyam/ /zhi ba'i sprin tshogs bzang po de dag kyang*/ /rab bzang dad pa'i glog phreng gar byed cing*/ /snyan pa'i 'brug sgra zab mor sgrogs pa ni/ /gnas kyi yon tan bsngags par zhugs pa bzhin/ /ston dus mdangs bzang mdzes pa'i ri ngogs la/ /sman shing me tog 'bras bu'i tshogs smin pa/ /lha yi skyed tshal dar ba 'phos pa bzhin// kun nas mdzes pa'i rang bzhin 'di la gzigs/ /dgun dus lhun po gangs ri'i cod pan can/ /kha ba'i gos dkar bzang pos g.yogs pa ni/ /shel ri 'od kyi dra bas mdzes pa 'am/ /ku mud tshal du ston zla shar ba bzhin/ /res 'ga' shing rnams dung gi ljon pa la/ /pad+ma dkar po'i me tog rgyas pa bzhin/ /sa gzhi rin chen dngul gyis g.yogs 'dra la/ /rab dkar ngang pa mang po lhags pa bzhin/ /dpyid dus sa mchog yon tan mang po'i ri/ /rgyar yang lhun stugs nags tshal dra bas g.yogs/ /rtsi shing sman dang me tog kha 'bus shing*/ /dri zhim spos ngad ldan pas phyogs kun khyab/ /'di ni sngon med rin chen lhun po zhig

/grub pa'i gnas 'di gsal bas mdzes las sam/ /rnam par 'phrul la yon tan bsam mi khyab/ /sna tshogs bkod pa'i 'od zer 'gyed la ltos/ /de 'dra'i lhun po rin chen mchog tshogs can/ /byams pa gdan bzhugs 'dra ba'i thugs ka la/ /thar pa gling gi sgrub gnas mdzes pa ni/ /dpal ri pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas bzhin/ /'di ni ri rgyal rab tu lhun mtho la/ /nags tshal sman shing me tog chu gtsang dang*/ /ne'u gsing sman ljongs du mas rab brgyan zhing*/ /dgon pa'i sa gzhi dag kyang rab tu mdzes/ /sa dang gnam yang nyi 'od rgyun ring la/ /dbyar bsil dgun dro dus bzhi bsil drod mnyam/ /chu dang shing bzang ngang gis sdod snying 'dod/ /grong las rgyang ring dben pa'i nags khrod lags/ /'di na rang bzhin 'tshe ba med pa dang*/ /mthun rkyen sgrub sla bsam gtan ngang gis 'phel/ /bcud len rdzas kyang rnam pa grangs mang la/ /shing tog sngo ngad mang po'i kha zas ldan/ /mthong bas chags shing bsten pas yid spro la/ /ngang gis chos 'phel sems gtsang rig pa 'dzin/ /rgyun du yid dga' dag pa'i zhing khams bzhin/ /zhi ba rab bzang thar pa'i gling mchog lags/ /'di ni sngon tshe rang byung pad+ma yis/ /lung bstan zab gter byin rlabs 'byor pas brgyan/ /mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs 'du ba/ /bar chad med cing dngos grub nye ba lags/ /de 'dra'i gnas 'dir pad+ma'i byin rlabs las/ /rgyal sras dri med 'od zer legs 'ongs te/ /smon lam lung bstan bzhin du sgrub pa'i phyir/ /bsti gnas bcas te bsam gtan sgom pa legs/ /deng song dus na skye bo mi bsrun pas/ /dbus gtsang rgyal ba'i bstan pa nub tu nye/ /mtha' dmag 'byung pos yul gyi dbus dkrugs pas/ /'di 'dra'i gnas su byang chub sgrub par rigs/ /phyogs kyi sbas yul rin chen sgo rnams kyang*/ /ring por mi thogs myur du 'byed 'gyur la/ /sog po'i mtha' dmag rnams kyang 'byung du nye/

/'di 'dra'i rgyu mtshan bsam zhing skyo ba 'phel/ /de bas dad ldan thar pa 'dod rnams kyis/ /rang gi yul la zhen pa rab spangs la/ /tshe gang zab mo'i de nyid bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /phyogs kyi sbas yul bgrod pa'i dus la bab/ /sbas pa'i yul dang yul 'dra thams cad na/ /las mthun dge ba can rnams gnas pa dang*/ /mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtshos legs skyong bas/ /'tshe ba med cing chos dang mthun pa lags/ /mon yul bum thang dge ba'i gnas mchog 'di//mon du btags kyang bod yul dbus dang mtshungs/ / sbas yul min yang yul 'dra'i bye brag ste/ /de phyir mkhas rnams dga' ba bskyed par rigs/ /yul 'dir bgrod nas thar pa sgrub pa gang*/ /dpag med bskal pa rgya mtsho'i rdul snyed nas/ /las dang smon lam mchog tu dag pas na/ /tshe 'dis srid pa'i rgya mtsho brgal ba la/ /gnas 'dir rang byung pad+mas skyabs mdzad pas/ /'tshe ba med cing dam chos 'phel ba che/ /mkha' 'gro rnams dang skal ba mthun pas na/ /o rgyan la sogs dag pa'i gnas mchog bzhin/ /tshul 'di bum thang yul gyi bkod pa ste/ /dad ldan thar ba 'dod rnams bskul ba dang*/ /phyogs kyi skye bo rnams la bsgrag pa dang*/ /blo gsal rnams la mgrin pa'i rgyan du 'bul/ /dge ba 'di yis bdag dang 'gro ba kun/ /srid pa'i rgya mtsho ma lus rab brgal nas/ /zhi ba rab bzang thar pa'i skyed tshal du/ /sku gsum lhun grub chos kyi rgyal por shog /deng nas bdag blo srid la rab skyo bas/ /tshe 'di'i rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzi kun spangs te/ /nags tshal zhi ba chos kyi dgon pa'i gnas / / thar pa'i gling du sgrub pa 'phel bar shog /blo gros lhun po snyan ngag nags 'khrigs shing*/ /sdeb sbyor chu klung legs par 'bab pa'i gnas/ /mngon brjod pad+ma'i tshal gyis bkra ba 'dis/ /dad ldan skye bo'i tshogs rnams dga' bar mdzod/ /bum thang lha'i sbas yul gyi bkod pa gsal bar byed pa me tog gi skyed mos tshal zhes bya ba/

bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab la mang du thos pa'i nor gyis phyug cing*/ snyan dngags dang*/ sdeb sbyor/ mngon brjod kyi gnas la mkhas pa theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa dri med 'od zer gyi shing mo lug gi lo la bum thang thar pa'i gling du legs par sbyar ba rdzogs so/ /sarba maṅga laṃ// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (24) bum thang lha'i sbas yul gyi bkod pa me tog skyed tshal/ -PAGE 32--PAGE 33--30-
